thread:
mira: Heads-up — Sable (large fintech) asked today for a firm commit: private deployment (VPC + on-prem option), KMS/HSM integration, and dedicated GPU capacity. They want go-live by 2026-06-30. Is that realistic?

alex: Thanks Mira. Key asks: private control plane, KMS, model pinning, and 200 rps sustained with P95 <200ms. They also want audit logs and HIPAA-esque audit posture.

tom: 200 rps + P95 <200ms on private will depend on hardware perf and batching. Dedicated pool sizing estimate: ~4 x A100-equivalent for baseline, maybe more for bursts. Provision lead time ~3 weeks once infra-approved.

leo: VPC peering & network config for Sable's cloud could take 1–2 weeks of network work + security review. KMS/HSM integration requires an onboarding runbook and entitlements — estimate 2 weeks parallel.

jess: Sable is pushing hard — revenue & reference value high. They signed LOI but need delivery date for internal board. They prefer 6/30. If we miss, they’ll ask for price concessions.

raj: For private package we have an existing on-prem bundle but it needs the updated KMS flow. I can assemble the packaging and doc in ~7 business days if infra teams confirm APIs.

sam: Proposal: phased commitment. Phase 1 (hosted-driven private with dedicated pool + KMS mock): can target 2026-06-30 but with limited SLA. Phase 2 (full private control plane + HSM) by 2026-07-20. Canary rollout for 2 weeks, then full handover.

mira: Sable explicitly said no staged vendor fallback — they want full private by 6/30. Can we give a firm net date or at least a contingency plan?

tom: If legal/infra can sign off this week and we pre-schedule capacity, we can aim for an internal-ready deploy 6/30, but public/customer-ready (with HSM audit) likely later. Risk: KMS credential exchange and customer IT approvals are on Sable's side and often delayed.

alex: To be safe, propose we offer firm go/no-go checkpoint on 2026-06-10. If all infra+security deps green by then we commit to 6/30; otherwise we move MTO to 7/15. We should communicate that as a conditional commitment.

jess: Sounds reasonable. Action items: Mira -> escalate IT approvals to Sable and request KMS access window by 2026-05-31. Raj -> prep private package and KMS integration playbook by 2026-05-27. Leo -> block network review slot 2026-05-25. Tom -> confirm capacity lead time with infra (do today). Sam -> draft customer commitment language with contingency by EOD.

mira: Will do. Also asked CFO for dedicated pricing delta; Sable expects a 12-month reserved contract.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline note: created temporary canary pipeline 'sable-private-canary' (id: canary-142). Please add test plan link.

tom: I'll check capacity lead time now and update thread within 2 hours.

alex: One more: define launch criteria so we don't hand over prematurely. Minimums: load test pass at 200rps with P95 <200ms, successful KMS rotation test, audit log ingestion to SIEM, and 48-hour canary with no P1s. Add to the commitment doc.

mira: Great — I'll flag the 6/10 checkpoint in the account executive update and ask Sable to fast-track their IT approvals. :pray:

jess: I'll draft the post-mortem/rollback runbook in case of breach during canary. Small doc is fine.

sam: I'll assemble the commitment artifact (conditional timeline + launch criteria + pricing) and share a beta PR by EOD for review.

mira: Thanks team. If we can get the checkpoint sign-off, we can keep Sable on the 6/30 date. Otherwise we set expectation to 7/15.

alex: Keeping this thread as the single source for the customer commitment. Please update only here.

(timestamps: initial ask 1911112222, latest update 1911112600)
